3006.sent:
// Detects KERNEL_* env-var with YAML-injection markers in EG application syslog or WAF body logs.
// CommonSecurityLog does NOT carry DeviceName — use DestinationHostName / SourceIP for host pivots.
let InjectionMarkers = @"(?i)KERNEL_[A-Z_]+[^\n]{0,200}(---|\.\.\.|securityContext|runAsUser|runAsGroup|fsGroup|privileged\s*:\s*true)";
union isfuzzy=true
(
  Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where ProcessName has_any ("enterprise_gateway", "enterprise-gateway", "jupyter") or SyslogMessage has "/api/kernels"
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=Computer, HostName, ProcessName, Evidence=SyslogMessage
),
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestURL has "/api/kernels" and RequestMethod =~ "POST"
  | where Message matches regex InjectionMarkers or DeviceCustomString1 matches regex InjectionMarkers or AdditionalExtensions matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="WAF/Proxy", Host=DestinationHostName, SourceIP=SourceIP, ProcessName=DeviceProduct, Evidence=coalesce(Message, DeviceCustomString1, AdditionalExtensions)
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csUriStem == "/api/kernels" and csMethod =~ "POST"
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="IIS", Host=Computer, SourceIP=cIP, ProcessName="w3wp", Evidence=strcat(csMethod, " ", csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery)
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
3006.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.url="*/api/kernels*" by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.url, Web.http_user_agent, Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src dest [ search (sourcetype=nginx:plus:access OR sourcetype=ingress:nginx OR sourcetype=kube:container:enterprise-gateway OR sourcetype=istio:envoy:access) "/api/kernels" "KERNEL_" ("---" OR "..." OR "securityContext" OR "runAsUser" OR "fsGroup" OR "privileged") | table _time src dest _raw ]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);

              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;

    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)

    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (npmParents)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,

              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = "<network-egress>", ChildCmd = RemoteUrl, SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;

let Lookback = 7d;

| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)

| where Url matches regex @"(?i)/workspaces/[^/]+/members/[^/?#]+"
| where HttpStatusCode in ("200","204")
| extend Workspace = extract(@"(?i)/workspaces/([^/]+)/members/", 1, Url)

            TargetsTouched = dcount(TargetUser),

description: Detects presence of vm2 npm module package.json on endpoints, indicating exposure to CVE-2026-47208 sandbox escape (vm2 <= 3.11.3).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-76w7-j9cq-rx2j
  - https://github.com/patriksimek/vm2/security/advisories/GHSA-qvjj-29qf-hp7p
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\node_modules\vm2\package.json'
      - '/node_modules/vm2/package.json'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Developer workstations and CI build agents legitimately depending on vm2
  - Legacy applications pending migration to isolated-vm
level: medium
3104.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="package.json" Filesystem.file_path="*\\node_modules\\vm2\\package.json" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

3105.def:
// vm2 sandbox escape -> child_process.execSync spawns host process from node.exe
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","touch.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where not (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("npm install","npm ci","npm run","yarn install","pnpm install","node-gyp","electron-builder","husky","postinstall"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildPath  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc
3105.sent:
// ASIM process-create — node.exe parent spawning shell/cmd/touch after vm2 escape
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ParentProcessName endswith "node.exe"
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","touch.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe")
| where not (ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("npm install","npm ci","npm run","yarn","pnpm","node-gyp","electron","postinstall","husky"))
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects node.exe spawning shells, touch, curl, or LOLBins — the post-escape behavioural signature of CVE-2026-47208 vm2 Promise species sandbox escape via child_process.execSync.

tags:

  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\touch.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'

3106.def:
// Hunts CVE-2026-47208 PoC fingerprint in node.exe cmdlines AND .js file drops
let poc_strings = dynamic([
    "constructor.constructor(\"return process\")",
    "constructor.constructor('return process')",
    "mainModule.require('child_process')",
    "mainModule.require(\"child_process\")",
    "Symbol.species"
]);
let cmdline_hits =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName in~ ("node.exe","nodejs.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (poc_strings)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source = "cmdline",
              Evidence = ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let file_hits =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName endswith ".js" or FileName endswith ".mjs" or FileName endswith ".cjs"
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (poc_strings) or FolderPath has "vm2"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Source = "file",
              Evidence = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union cmdline_hits, file_hits
| order by Timestamp desc
3106.sent:
// Sentinel ImProcessCreate variant — PoC strings in node.exe command lines
let poc_strings = dynamic([
    'constructor.constructor("return process")',
    "constructor.constructor('return process')",
    "mainModule.require('child_process')",
    'mainModule.require("child_process")',
    "Symbol.species"
]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("node.exe","nodejs.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (poc_strings)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,

| order by TimeGenerated desc

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, HostName, CommandLine], function=count())

3134.sigma:
title: Oracle EBS Concurrent Processing Spawns OS Shell or Downloader (CVE-2025-61882)
id: 1e7a8b04-3c6f-4a18-9b6d-72bb5a9e2c11
status: experimental
description: Detects Oracle E-Business Suite java/FNDLIBR/httpd parent processes spawning shells, wget, curl, perl, python or nc — the post-exploit footprint of CVE-2025-61882 (Cl0p / Hazy Scorpius extortion campaign).
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cyber-extortion-economy/
  - https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/alert-cve-2025-61882.html
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/oracle-ebusiness-suite-zero-day-exploitation
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - cve.2025.61882
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/java'
      - '/FNDLIBR'
      - '/httpd'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'oracle'
      - 'EBS'
      - 'fs_inst'
      - 'appsutil'
      - 'comn/util'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/ksh'
      - '/wget'
      - '/curl'
      - '/perl'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
  filter_legit:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'adstrtal'
      - 'adstpall'
      - 'adcfgclone'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Oracle EBS patching (autoconfig, adop) which legitimately spawns shells under java
  - Administrative concurrent programs that shell out by design
level: high
3134.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java","java.exe","FNDLIBR","FNDLIBR.exe","httpd","httpd.exe")) AND (Processes.parent_process="*oracle*" OR Processes.parent_process="*EBS*" OR Processes.parent_process="*fs_inst*" OR Processes.parent_process="*ConcurrentProcessing*") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","ksh","zsh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wget","curl","perl","python","python3","nc","ncat")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3134.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.parent.executable.path:(*/java OR */FNDLIBR OR */httpd) @process.executable.path:(*/sh OR */bash OR */ksh OR */wget OR */curl OR */perl OR */python OR */python3 OR */nc OR */ncat) -@process.command_line:(*adstrtal* OR *adstpall* OR *adcfgclone*)
3134.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(java|FNDLIBR|httpd)$/i
| regex("(oracle|EBS|fs_inst|appsutil|FMW_Home|comn/util|Concurrent)", field=ParentImageFileName)
| ImageFileName=/\/(sh|bash|ksh|zsh|wget|curl|perl|python3?|nc|ncat)$|\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil)\.exe$/i
| NOT (regex("(adstrtal|adstpall|adcfgclone)", field=CommandLine))

3143.sigma:
title: Mini Shai-Hulud gh-token-monitor Persistence Daemon Created
id: c1a9d2f4-3e77-4b86-9a02-5f6b7c8e9d10
description: Detects the Mini Shai-Hulud worm installing its gh-token-monitor LaunchAgent/systemd persistence daemon.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/mini-shai-hulud-is-back-a-self-spreading-supply-chain-attack-hits-the-npm-ecosystem
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/27
tags:
  - attack.t1543.001
  - attack.t1543.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: 'gh-token-monitor'
  condition: selection
level: high
3143.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*gh-token-monitor*" OR (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*LaunchAgents*","*LaunchDaemons*","*/etc/systemd/system/*","*.config/systemd/user/*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*token*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3143.datadog: source:linux.auditd (@process.command_line:*gh-token-monitor* OR @process.name:gh-token-monitor OR @process.command_line:(*"launchctl load"*gh-token* OR *"systemctl enable"*gh-token*))
3143.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/gh-token-monitor/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

3144.sigma:
title: Package Manager Writing GitHub Actions Workflow (Mini Shai-Hulud Injection)
id: a4e8b91c-7d2f-4c63-8b1a-9e0d3f2c6a55
description: Detects node/npm/bun writing .github/workflows files, the Mini Shai-Hulud worm's secret-exfil self-propagation injection.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/mini-shai-hulud-is-back-a-self-spreading-supply-chain-attack-hits-the-npm-ecosystem
  - https://www.ox.security/blog/lightning-python-package-shai-hulud-supply-chain-attack/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/27
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1552.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\.github\workflows\'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npx.exe'
      - '\bun.exe'
  filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.yml'
      - '.yaml'
  condition: selection and filename
level: medium
3144.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\.github\\workflows\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.github/workflows/*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.yml" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.yaml") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_guid
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

3145.sigma:
title: BTMOB Android RAT C2 Domain Contact - arbsniper.com
id: 7d2a9c81-4f3b-4b15-9c7a-2e8a1f0d4c52
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS resolution or network/web request to arbsniper.com, BTMOB Android RAT C2/phishing infrastructure tracked by ESET (April 2026) and Cyble (Feb 2025).
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/malware/btmob-stealthy-rat-burrowing-deep-android-devices/
  - https://cyble.com/blog/btmob-rat-newly-discovered-android-malware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/30
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1583.001
detection:
  selection_dns:
    QueryName|endswith: 'arbsniper.com'
  selection_url:
    Url|contains: 'arbsniper.com'
  selection_dest:
    DestinationHostname|endswith: 'arbsniper.com'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
logsource:
  category: dns
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Threat-intel research traffic to the indicator from a known sandbox/analyst host
  - Web crawlers indexing the BTMOB landing page
3145.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(DNS.src) as src values(DNS.query) as query from datamodel=Network_Resolution where DNS.query="*arbsniper.com" by DNS.src DNS.query | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.src) as src values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_host="*arbsniper.com" OR All_Traffic.url="*arbsniper.com*" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_host | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`] | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.src) as src values(Web.url) as url from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*arbsniper.com*" by Web.src Web.url | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3145.datadog: (@network.destination.ip:* AND (@dns.question.name:*arbsniper.com OR @url:*arbsniper.com* OR @http.url:*arbsniper.com* OR @DestinationHostname:*arbsniper.com OR @QueryName:*arbsniper.com)) AND source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security OR zeek OR suricata OR proxy OR cloudflare OR cloudtrail)
3145.falcon: (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/arbsniper\.com$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|outlook|teams)\.exe$/i) | regex("arbsniper\.com", field=DomainName) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName, RemoteAddressIP4], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])

3148.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Laravel Lang Supply Chain Advisory
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/run/secrets/") or FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3148.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Laravel Lang Supply Chain Advisory ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("debugchromium.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/var/run/secrets/*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("debugchromium.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

description: Detects ssh.exe launched with the -R (reverse port forward) flag on Windows hosts spawned by a script interpreter or PsExec/PAExec - Cloud Atlas backup C2 via patched OpenSSH.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/cloud-atlas-2026/119895/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.t1572
  - attack.t1090.001
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ssh.exe'
  selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -R '
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\PsExec.exe'
      - '\paexec.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_flag and selection_parent
level: high
3170.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=ssh.exe Processes.process="* -R *" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(parent_process_name, "(?i)^(wscript|cscript|cmd|powershell|psexec|paexec|services)\.exe$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
3170.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\ssh.exe OR *\\SSH.EXE OR *\\Ssh.exe) @CommandLine:"* -R *" @ParentImage:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\PsExec.exe OR *\\PSEXEC.EXE OR *\\paexec.exe OR *\\PAExec.exe OR *\\services.exe)
3170.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\ssh\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\s-R\\s+\\S+", field=CommandLine)
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(wscript|cscript|cmd|powershell|pwsh|psexec|psexec64|paexec|services)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

title: Click or Navigation to Fake FIFA World Cup 2026 Typosquat Domain
id: 7c0e1f4a-8a6f-4f3d-9b1a-2f8c1d3e4b91
description: Detects browser navigation to known fake FIFA World Cup 2026 phishing domains and typosquat patterns reported by ESET.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/cybersecurity/foul-play-fake-fifa-world-cup-websites-tickets/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.t1583.001
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_known:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'fifa26.shop'
      - '26-fifa.com'
  selection_pattern:
    c-uri|re|i: '(fifa.*(26|2026|worldcup)|(26|2026|worldcup).*fifa)\.(shop|store|online|xyz|top|site|com)'
  filter_legit:
    c-uri|contains:

3171.falcon:

| DomainName=/(?i)(fifa.*(26|2026|worldcup)|(26|2026|worldcup).*fifa)\.(shop|store|online|xyz|top|site|com)/ OR DomainName=/(?i)^(fifa26\.shop|26-fifa\.com)$/

3172.def:

let KnownBad = dynamic(['fifa26.shop','26-fifa.com']);
DeviceNetworkEvents

title: BadIIS-style Native Module Dropped Into IIS Path by Non-Installer Process
id: a3c0f1c8-8b62-4f1d-9c4e-d70e5c0e1f12
description: Detects file writes of DLL or EXE payloads into IIS-served directories (\inetsrv\, \inetpub\wwwroot\bin\) by a process that is NOT msiexec / TrustedInstaller / appcmd / drvinst. Aligns with Cisco Talos BadIIS commodity variant (May 2026) whose modules drop into IIS module paths and carry 'demo.pdb' strings.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-art-of-being-ungovernable/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.004
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_paths:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetsrv\'
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\bin\'
      - '\inetpub\custerr\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.dll'
      - '.exe'
  filter_trusted_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\appcmd.exe'
      - '\WindowsUpdateBox.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
  condition: selection_paths and not filter_trusted_installers
falsepositives:
  - Custom IIS deployment tooling outside of MSI / appcmd workflow
  - Web-app CI/CD pipelines that drop assemblies into bin\
level: medium

3176.sent:
let lookback = 7d;
let bucket = 1h;
let BadIISSignals = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where csMethod in~ ("GET","HEAD","POST")
| summarize Total = count(),
           Status503 = countif(scStatus == 503),
           Status3xx = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           DistinctClients = dcount(cIP),
           DistinctURIs = dcount(csUriStem),
           SampleUserAgents = make_set(csUserAgent, 5),
           SampleReferers = make_set(csReferer, 5)
           by Computer, sSiteName, bin(TimeGenerated, bucket)
| extend PctErr503 = round((Status503 * 100.0) / Total, 2),
         PctRedirect = round((Status3xx * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| where (Status503 >= 50 and PctErr503 >= 20) or (Status3xx >= 100 and PctRedirect >= 40);
let Baseline = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(lookback))
| summarize BaselineTotal = count(),
           BaselineRedirect = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           Baseline503 = countif(scStatus == 503)
           by Computer, sSiteName
| extend BaselinePctRedirect = round((BaselineRedirect * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2),
         BaselinePctErr503 = round((Baseline503 * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2);
BadIISSignals
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on Computer, sSiteName
| where PctRedirect >= (coalesce(BaselinePctRedirect, 0.0) * 3) or PctErr503 >= (coalesce(BaselinePctErr503, 0.0) * 3)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, Total, Status503, Status3xx, PctErr503, PctRedirect, BaselinePctRedirect, BaselinePctErr503, DistinctClients, DistinctURIs, SampleUserAgents, SampleReferers

description: Detects the Python backdoor cat.py (or its __DAEMONIZED=1 self-relaunch) launched by a VS Code helper, Cursor helper, node or shell parent. Specific to the May 2026 Nx Console v18.95.0 supply-chain compromise.

    - attack.execution
    - attack.persistence

    category: process_creation

        Image|endswith:
            - '/python'
            - '/python3'
            - '/python3.9'
            - '/python3.10'
            - '/python3.11'

3189.def:

| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","node.exe","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)","cursor-helper","Cursor","Code","code.exe","cursor.exe","python","python3")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/.ssh/","/.aws/","/.config/gcloud/","/.kube/","/.docker/","/.gnupg/","/.claude/")
     or FileName in~ ("id_rsa","id_ed25519","id_ecdsa","credentials","known_hosts","authorized_keys",".npmrc","settings.json","config.json")
     or FileName =~ ".env" or FileName startswith ".env." or FolderPath has "/.npmrc")

| order by FirstSeen desc
